requests.problem: Current WS08 production startup intentionally fails closed because the WS07-backed repository adapter is not wired. Memory repository is correctly forbidden in production.
requests.required_change: Wire a production repository implementing every services/admin-api/src/repository.js REQUIRED_METHODS against the shared persistent data source, preserving authoritative online-character mutation boundaries and append-only audit semantics.
acceptance: Dangerous mutations remain permission-checked, transactional, idempotent where contracted, and audited.
No seeded example accounts or demo records are reachable in production.

requests.problem: POST /commands returns an authoritative queued request (currently PENDING_BRIDGE) but WS08 exposes no read contract for terminal execution state. A frontend therefore cannot truthfully report succeeded/failed after enqueue.
requests.required_change: Expose a permission-protected command request status/read contract keyed by request id or trace id, with explicit lifecycle states at minimum PENDING, SUCCEEDED and FAILED plus timestamps/error summary. Keep POST /commands as queue acceptance, not execution success.
requests.frontend_interim: The v10 frontend displays the exact queued status/request id/trace and explicitly does not label the command as executed. It does not synthesize terminal success/failure.
acceptance: A queued request can be polled/read until terminal state.
Succeeded means the authoritative game command bridge executed it, not merely that the DB/outbox write succeeded.
Failed state contains a non-sensitive operator-visible reason and remains auditable.

non_blocking_missing_contracts.detail: No current WS08 endpoint exists for maintenance/restart/shutdown. The accepted v10 controls are rendered disabled rather than faking success. Add a separately reviewed backend contract only if these operations are to be enabled.
